name: SplitButton
title: Components/Actions/SplitButton
description: Pair one frequent action with a menu of alternatives. Both segments use native buttons; Tab reaches each, Enter or Space runs the primary action, and the menu supports Arrow keys, Home/End, Enter, and Escape. Promise-returning callbacks disable both segments until completion, prevent duplicate requests, and display a recoverable error on rejection. Focus returns after completion unless the user moved elsewhere. Use menuLabel to describe the alternatives.
